prompt: The script fails with 'cannot read null' because it runs before the button exists.
why: Code in the head runs before the body is built. That's load order.
trap: The lookup fails, but because of when it runs.

prompt: Adding defer makes the script wait until the HTML is parsed.
why: defer changes when the script runs. That's load order.
trap: It isn't fetching data; it's script timing.

prompt: The page stays blank while a large script in the head downloads.
tells: a large script in the head downloads
why: Scripts in the head block the page until they load.
trap: It's waiting, but on the script itself, not data.

prompt: The chart code fails because the chart library is loaded after it.
tells: the chart library is loaded after it
why: Scripts run in order, so dependencies must load first.
trap: Nothing is fetched; the order is wrong.

prompt: Moving the script tag to the end of the body fixes the error.
tells: to the end of the body
why: At the end, the elements already exist. That's load order.
trap: It's an HTML change, but the fix is timing.

prompt: The page flashes unstyled for a moment because the stylesheet loads late.
why: When the CSS arrives after the HTML, you see a flash. That's load order.
